title: חדשות ארכיאולוגיות מעבר לגבול, חפירות בירושלים העתיקה (news from across the border: excavations in the Old City of Jerusalem)
author: (unsigned)
location_note: Jerusalem, Ophel (south-eastern hill) and the east slope of the western hill; no map reference.
notes: Second-hand summary, from the English press, of K. Kenyon's 1961 excavations for the British School of Archaeology; coded because it reports the season's fieldwork. Walls, towers and fortifications not eligible.

features.subtype: cellars of supporting structures used as rain-water pools
features.period: in use in the 7th century BCE, perhaps built in the 9th
features.quote: שמרתפיהם נוצלו כבריכות לאגירת מי גשמים

features.subtype: caves on the south-east slopes of the western hill, inhabited
features.period: first inhabited in the 1st century CE, occupied until the Byzantine and Arab periods
features.quote: נתגלו כאן מערות שנושבו לראשונה במאה הראשונה

title: משלחת למדבר יהודה - 1962 (Nahal Mishmar, Cave of the Treasure)
author: P. Bar-Adon
location_note: Nahal Mishmar caves; no map reference.
notes: Bundled with HA 3 in one PDF (HA 2 printed pp. 1-26 = PDF pp. 3-29). Cave B had Bar Kokhba and Chalcolithic remains from earlier seasons (not coded: earlier work). Chalcolithic building and stone lookout on the cliff top not eligible. OCR of this page is poor; quotes chosen from clean words.

features.subtype: Cave of the Treasure (Chalcolithic layer dug to the bottom) and Cave D (Shepherds' Cave, Iron Age pottery)
features.period: Chalcolithic; Israelite (Iron) period
features.quote: במערת המטמון נחפרה השכבה הכלקוליתית עד תומה

features.subtype: giant cave about 150 m long, corridors and halls, wooden beams, hearths, rope
features.period: undated (the report could not date the occupation)
features.quote: המערה מכילה פרוזדור צר וארוך חדר כניסה וכוך גדול

features.subtype: neighbouring caves B and C used for burial (child and adult burials, one in a leather bag)
features.period: Chalcolithic
features.quote: השכנות לה שימשו לקבורה

title: העונה השניה בעין-גדי (En Gedi, second season)
author: B. Mazar, I. Dunayevsky and T. Dothan
location_note: Tel Goren (Tell el-Jurn) and the En Gedi oasis; no map reference.
screen_note: HA 3 is bound after HA 2 in the portal file (PDF pp. 31-56, own pagination 1-25) and is missing from the portal table of contents; heading found in the text.
notes: The report states that Tel Goren has no remains of the end of the Second Temple period or of the time up to the Bar Kokhba revolt. Chalcolithic temple enclosure, Hasmonean fortress and Iron Age tower not eligible.

features.subtype: water installations: pools in the oasis
features.period: Roman-Byzantine
features.quote: ברכות אמות מים

features.subtype: water installations: water channels in the oasis
features.period: Roman-Byzantine
features.quote: ברכות אמות מים

features.subtype: covered pot holding a hoard of silver ingots, in the 'Tobshalem' house
features.period: stratum V, Josiah to the destruction (about 630-580 BCE)
features.quote: מכוסה נר ובו אוצר של

title: מערות קברים במוצא עילית (burial caves at Moza Illit)
author: V. Sussman
location_note: Ma'ale Moza Illit; no map reference.
screen_note: HA 3 part of the file; not in the portal table of contents.

features.subtype: single-chamber shaft tombs, two joined by a breach; a third cave with three skulls
features.period: Middle Canaanite (Middle Bronze) II B
features.quote: המערות הן מטיפוס קברי פיר בני חדר אחד

title: מצדה (Masada)
author: S. Guttman
location_note: Masada, top of the Snake Path; no map reference.
screen_note: HA 3 part of the file; not in the portal table of contents.
notes: Gate and waiting room with benches and painted plaster at the top of the Snake Path (Herodian style). No feature of the eligible classes.

title: חותם עברי נמצא בקרית יערים (Hebrew seal found at Qiryat Ye'arim)
author: (J. Naveh, reported)
location_note: Tell Qiryat Ye'arim (Deir el-Azhar) by Abu Ghosh; no map reference.
notes: Surface find of a seal of Yesha'yahu son of Amaryahu (end of the First Temple period). No feature of the eligible classes.

title: רמת רחל (Ramat Rahel, fifth season, first report)
author: Y. Aharoni
notes: Lower citadel wall, tower and a Roman building of the Tenth Legion not eligible. The intact tomb held two stone ossuaries, remains of wooden coffins, glass and about a dozen lamps.

features.subtype: rock-cut tomb cave found intact with its blocking stone; ossuaries and wooden coffins
features.period: lamps probably of the first third of the 2nd century CE
features.quote: מערה אחת נתגלתה במצבה המקורי עם אבן הסתימה

features.subtype: row of rock-cut tomb caves on the rocky slope north of the upper citadel
features.period: not dated in the report (one of them as above)
features.quote: במדרון הסלעי שמצפון למצודה העליונה נתגלתה שורה של

features.subtype: tomb caves converted to water cisterns
features.period: Roman and Byzantine periods
features.quote: אחדות מהן נהפכו לבורות מים בתקופות הרומית

title: קבר מימי הבית השני בירושלים (Second Temple period tomb in Jerusalem, old zoo area)
author: T. Dothan, Z. Yeivin and S. Nahfani
location_note: Area of the old zoo, Jerusalem (Romema); no map reference.
notes: Courtyard 10 x 15 m probably cut in an earlier quarry (not coded: the excavators' inference). Five decorated ossuaries in chamber B and nine in chamber D; an empty arcosolium; a square pit in the entrance chamber. The pottery date is printed as 'המאה הב' לסה״ג' (OCR-ambiguous; not used); the title dates the tomb to the Second Temple period.

features.subtype: family tomb: courtyard with bench, central cave of four chambers with kokhim, ossuaries and an arcosolium; second cave unfinished
features.period: Second Temple period (title)
features.quote: נתגלתה מערכת קברים שכללה חצר ושתי מערות

title: רמת רחל (Ramat Rahel, end of the fifth season)
author: Y. Aharoni (with M. Kochavi)
notes: Seven strata. Tombs of the late Second Temple village: glass, decorated lamps, ossuaries with Hebrew/Aramaic and Greek inscriptions; one sealed with its blocking stone. A proto-Aeolic capital reused as an altar inside a columbarium connected to a Second Temple tomb cave. A word in the monastery list is unreadable in the text layer ('בריאות'); not coded.

features.subtype: tomb caves of the late Second Temple village, one sealed; ossuaries with inscriptions
features.period: village from the 3rd century BCE to the end of the Second Temple period
features.quote: השנה נחשפו מערות קברים אחדות מתקופה זו

features.subtype: columbarium (cave with niches) connected to a Second Temple tomb cave; capital reused as an altar inside
features.period: not dated itself (connected to a Second Temple tomb cave)
features.quote: בתוך קולופבאריום פערה עם כוכים הקשור למערת קברים

features.subtype: rock-cut tunnel of man's height running parallel to the outer citadel wall near the gate; function not determined
features.period: not dated in the report
features.quote: חצובה בסלע הנמשכת בקו

features.subtype: oil press in the service rooms of the Kathisma monastery
features.period: Byzantine (church and monastery founded in the 5th century)
features.quote: קנקני אגירה גדולים בית בד

title: קברים יהודים ברוממה ירושלים (Jewish tombs in Romema, Jerusalem)
author: L. Y. Rahmani
location_note: Romema, Jerusalem (metal works yard); no map reference.
notes: Twenty-two ossuaries recovered. A later burial in the fill of the northern tomb with a lamp of the 3rd-4th century CE.

features.subtype: Jewish tomb of the usual form, opening facing north, used as a store for ossuaries
features.period: end of the Second Temple period
features.quote: קבר יהודי שצורתו רגילה ביותר

features.subtype: earlier southern tomb with two kokhim and a bone-collecting chamber, opening destroyed
features.period: earlier than the northern tomb; not dated
features.quote: האחד הדרומי זוא היותר קדום

title: מי נפתוח (Mei Naftoah, Lifta; survey news)
author: (survey staff)
screen_note: Sub-item of 'חדשות מן הסקר'; Mei Naftoah (Lifta) is within Jerusalem (not in the gazetteer by name; exploratory by-eye match).
location_note: Mei Naftoah (Lifta), Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: A large building re-examined and attributed to the Crusader period. No feature of the eligible classes.

title: חדשות ארכיאולוגיות מחו"ל: הירודיון (news from abroad: Herodium)
author: (from the Vatican bulletin, 2 October 1962)
location_note: Jebel Fureidis, 4 km south-east of Bethlehem (then in Jordan); no map reference.
notes: Second-hand summary of V. Corbo's 1962 excavations: circular fortress, towers, baths with wall paintings, mosaics, Byzantine monks' dwellings, an oven and a lime pit with Roman and Byzantine sherds, a Hebrew ostracon. No feature of the eligible classes (lime pit not eligible).

title: קברים מימי הבית הראשון, ליד מבשרת ציון (First Temple period tombs near Mevasseret Yerushalayim)
author: O. Negbi
location_note: Hill slope by the road from Lower Moza to Mevasseret Yerushalayim; no map reference.

features.subtype: rock-cut bench tombs with central pit and bone repositories; two excavated, more examined
features.period: pottery of the 8th-7th centuries BCE
features.quote: מערכת של מערות חצובות בסלע נתגלתה במדרון ההר

title: פעולות שימור בירושלים (conservation in Jerusalem: Jason's Tomb, Mamluk tomb buildings)
author: (Department of Antiquities, A. Tiran)
location_note: Jason's Tomb in Alfasi Street; the Kubakiya in Mamilla cemetery and the Qaimariya, Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: Restoration only; Jason's Tomb was excavated in 1956 (earlier work).

features.subtype: Jason's Tomb, built for a wealthy family of seafarers, restored
features.period: in the days of Alexander Jannaeus
features.quote: אשר הוקם למשפחת ימאים עשירים ביפי אלכסנדר ינאי

features.subtype: two Mamluk tomb buildings (Kubakiya, Qaimariya), repaired
features.period: Mamluk (burials of 1251-1289)
features.quote: עבודות התיקון והשיפור של שני בנייני קבורה

title: החפירה ברגם מס' 3 ליד ירושלים (excavation of cairn no. 3 near Jerusalem, Ir Ganim)
author: Z. Yeivin
location_note: Printed as '(נ״צ 128920 165952)', northing first; read as OIG E 165952 / N 128920 (Ir Ganim B, Jerusalem). INFERENCE: swapped order.
notes: Cairn (rujm) of the 7th century BCE with an earlier agricultural terrace; not eligible.

features.subtype: two water cisterns and installations about 40 m east of the cairn
features.period: not dated in the report
features.quote: נמצאו שני בורות מים ומתקנים נוספים

title: קבר יסון בירושלים (Jason's Tomb in Jerusalem)
author: (Department of Antiquities)
location_note: Jason's Tomb, Rehavia; no map reference.
notes: Note on the completed restoration; same feature as HA06-016 (Jason's Tomb). Excavated in 1956 (earlier work).

features.subtype: Jason's Tomb with its courtyards, restored
features.period: Alexander Jannaeus to Herod; one burial in 50/51 CE
features.quote: שייך היה ים לאיש יהודי רם מעלה שחי בימי אלכסנדר ינאי

title: פפירוסים ארמיים במערה צפונית ליריחו (Aramaic papyri in a cave north of Jericho, Wadi ed-Daliyeh)
author: (from F. M. Cross)
location_note: Mugharet Abu Shinjeh, south side of Wadi ed-Daliyeh, 14 km north of Jericho and 12 km west of the Jordan (text); zone by the title's name (Jericho). INFERENCE: the cave lies within the Z2 or northern Z3 box.
notes: Second-hand report of P. Lapp's January 1963 excavation (then in Jordan). About 40 papyri, 128 bullae, two gold seal rings, 80 skeletons excavated (about 200 estimated); documents of Samaria, 375-335 BCE. Not in a held area (north of Wadi Nuweimeh).

features.subtype: cave about 65 m deep with papyri, bullae, seal rings and many skeletons (refugees)
features.period: 4th century BCE (documents 375-335 BCE)
features.quote: בצלע הדרומית של ואדי דאלייה

title: מצדה (Masada)
author: Y. Yadin
notes: Two-line note that the excavations continue; no description.

title: מערת קברים בירושלים (tomb cave in Jerusalem, Mount Herzl military cemetery)
author: A. Tiran
location_note: Mount Herzl military cemetery, Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: Rock-cut courtyard with five steps, a complete ossuary with lid and ossuary fragments, two decorated lamps, a cooking pot; used for several generations; no date stated.

features.subtype: rock-cut tomb: courtyard, narrow entrance with blocking stone, chamber with three kokhim; ossuaries
features.period: not dated in the report
features.quote: פתח צר עם אבן סגירה מוביל אל חדר קבורה
